#show heading.where(level: 1): it => {
  set text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold")

  it.body
  v(-0.4em)

#let entry(title, org, date, location: none) = {
  grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    gutter: 0pt,
    [*#title* #if org != none [\ #emph(org)]],

  )
}

# Profile

Neuroscientist and research software engineer passionate about open, collaborative,
and reproducible science. I build open-source tools to study brains and the behaviours
they produce, with a background in medicine and a PhD in neuroimaging. Fellow of the
Software Sustainability Institute (SSI) and lead developer of
[movement](https://movement.neuroinformatics.dev), a Python package for analysing
animal motion.

## Current Position

```{=typst}
#entry(
  "Senior Research Software Engineer",
  "Neuroinformatics Unit · Sainsbury Wellcome Centre · Gatsby Computational Neuroscience Unit · University College London",
  "2022 – present",
  location: "London, UK",
)
```

- Lead developer of [movement](https://movement.neuroinformatics.dev), a Python toolbox for analysing animal body movements
- Core contributor to [BrainGlobe](https://brainglobe.info/), an ecosystem of neuroanatomy tools
- Building new brain atlases for emerging model organisms via [brainglobe-template-builder](https://github.com/brainglobe/brainglobe-template-builder)
- Promoting open-source adoption through training workshops for early-career researchers

## Key Projects

```{=typst}
#entry([*movement*], [neuroinformatics.dev], "2023 – present")
```
Python package for analysing body movements across space and time.
[movement.neuroinformatics.dev](https://movement.neuroinformatics.dev)

```{=typst}
#entry([*Animals in Motion*], [neuroinformatics.dev], "2024 – present")
```
Handbook about open-source tools for tracking animals in videos and quantifying behaviour.
[animals-in-motion.neuroinformatics.dev](https://animals-in-motion.neuroinformatics.dev/latest/)

```{=typst}
#entry([*BrainGlobe*], [brainglobe.info], "2022 – present")
```
Ecosystem of Python tools for neuroanatomy, including atlas creation and registration.
[brainglobe.info](https://brainglobe.info/)

```{=typst}
#entry([*NeuroBlueprint*], [neuroinformatics.dev], "2024 – present")
```
Lightweight data specification for systems neuroscience, inspired by BIDS.
[neuroblueprint.neuroinformatics.dev](https://neuroblueprint.neuroinformatics.dev)
